eraka: eraka  (adj.) [fr. ereti] driving away, moving J IV.20 (°vāta); °vattika a certain kind of torture M I.87 = A I.47 = II.122 = Nd2 604 = Miln 197.
eraka2 (nt.) [fr. ereti] Typha--grass J IV.88. As eragu(?) a kind of grass used for making coverlets Vin I.196 (eraka Bdhgh. on D I.166).
eraṇḍa: eraṇḍa [dial.?] the castor oil plant Nd2 680II.; J II.440. Cp. elaṇḍa.
erāvaṇa: erāvaṇa N. of Indra"s elephant Sn 379; Vv 4413; VvA 15.
erita: erita [pp. of ereti] moved, shaken, driven J IV.424; Vv 394, 424; Th 1, 104, Pv II.123; Vism 172 (+ samerita), 342 (vāt° moved by the wind). Cp. īrita.
ereti: ereti [=īreQ (q. v.) Caus. of īr, Sk. īrayati] to move, set into motion, raise (one"s voice) M I.21; Sn 350 (eraya imper.); Th 1, 209 (eraye); J IV.478. -- pp. erita (q.v.).
